policy.reason: Instagram profiles are login-gated and the Meta Terms of Service prohibit automated collection. TIKUM performs no scraping, no login, no anti-bot circumvention, no proxy rotation and no private-endpoint access.
policy.invariant: Tier 3 can DISCOVER. Tier 3 can NEVER verify. Verification is established exclusively by an official Indonesian authority channel (promoter / organizer / official event website / venue).

handles.notes: Primary Indonesian local concert discovery channel. Monitored as a candidate feeder only; every announcement must be corroborated by an official Indonesian promoter, organizer, venue or official event website.

Official Instagram channel of the Live Nation Asia promoter. Announcements are corroborated against the official public calendar at livenation.asia (src-livenation) and the official Indonesian event websites.

Official Instagram channel of Ticketmaster Asia. ticketmaster.asia does not resolve (DNS) and regional Ticketmaster hosts return HTTP 401, so verification requires the licensed Ticketmaster Discovery API (TICKETMASTER_API_KEY). Until that credential is provisioned, this handle can only feed the admin verification queue.
